review.rationale: Methodological contract for Test Card T019. The evidence decision lives in docs/standard. Differential acceleration and sensitivity table are taken from the published analysis.

question: How strongly can the UET portal (charge = nucleon number) couple at ranges 1 cm to 1e5 m, given the Rot-Wash equivalence-principle data?

output.quantity: alpha_max and g_c_max at 19 ranges from 0.01 m to 1e5 m
output.domain: Eot-Wash Rot-Wash apparatus, Cu and Pb test bodies, 238U attractor
output.accuracy: 95 percent symmetric limit on |Delta a| as published; S held at its 50 m value beyond 50 m (Earth term <= 1.4 percent).

model.assumptions: Portal charge per mass eps = (B/mu)(m_N/u) (T016 lane).
model.approximation: Earth and centrifugal terms of Eq. (26) omitted.
model.parameters: No fitting; alpha_max from published |Delta a| and S.

data_policy.holdout_policy: No holdout. Published summary seen before drafting (SEEN_SUMMARY), declared in Test Card T019.

system_partition.boundary: Torsion balance and rotating attractor; published values used only.

systems.state: Cu and Pb test bodies and 238U attractor

couplings.map: Gravity gradients and tilt handled upstream

observables.quantity: differential acceleration Cu - Pb toward the attractor
observables.readout_map: Published Delta a and S table; read only

components.reason: Applied upstream in the published analysis (Smith et al. 2000); not recomputed here.

error_budget.approximation: S held at 50 m value up to 1e5 m; Earth term <= 1.4 percent, centrifugal 0.16 percent.
error_budget.measurement: |Delta a| 95 percent limit 5.7e-13 cm/s^2 as published.
error_budget.systematic: Transcription checked against search-tool full text, not the printed page; lane choice (nucleon-number charge) is an AI interpretation.
error_budget.omissions: Earth-sourced EP tests (better at 1 km - 1e5 m) not used.
error_budget.acceptance: Outcome categories fixed in Test Card T019.

claim_boundary: Methodological coverage of the T019 comparison only; the evidence level is set in docs/standard. Not UET-distinct (any baryon-coupled scalar).
next_action: Add Earth-sourced EP bounds for 1 km - 1e5 m with an Earth model if a tighter bound is needed.
